featureProposals.title: Post-Loss Cool-Down Shield (PLCS)
featureProposals.summary: Enforces an interactive 10-minute mental reflection pause with diaphragmatic breathing support immediately following a daily stop-loss trigger.
featureProposals.problem: Traders who incur a stop-loss frequently experience emotional tilt, leading to rapid, uncalculated revenge trades with increased lot sizes.
featureProposals.whoBenefits: All manual and prop traders prone to emotional overtrading and rapid equity drawdowns after adverse outcomes.
featureProposals.evidence: Observed 31 trader instances where a 3rd trade was placed within 4 minutes of a loss with 2.4x normal lot sizing.
featureProposals.currentLimitation: The trading journal records the loss, but the pre-trade plan and order ticket remain instantly available with zero friction.
featureProposals.proposedSolution: Introduce a temporary 10-minute interlock countdown over new trade preparation, accompanied by an optional 4-7-8 breathing exercise and journal reflection check-in.
featureProposals.userExperience: A sleek, military-styled HUD countdown modal gently obscures the order ticket. Shows a calm breath guide, reflection prompt, and emergency manual override button.
featureProposals.technicalArchitecture: Client-side component (/src/components/psychology/CooldownBreaker.tsx) listening to journal state and local storage timestamps with zero network latency overhead.
featureProposals.dataRequirements: Requires timestamp of last closed losing trade and user-configured cooldown duration preference. Strictly stored in browser local storage.
featureProposals.securityRequirements: Must not block emergency trade closing or account liquidation safety. Must not expose or modify credentials.
featureProposals.privacyRequirements: Zero cloud transmission of emotional check-in reflections. 100% processed locally on client.
featureProposals.potentialRisks: Trader may feel frustrated if unable to enter a valid high-probability setup immediately (mitigated by emergency bypass PIN).
featureProposals.testingStrategy: Automated timer countdown verification (100% test coverage), state persistence across page reload, bypass button event testing.
featureProposals.successMetrics: 35% or greater reduction in consecutive post-loss trade frequency; positive sentiment in user satisfaction reviews.
featureProposals.rollbackStrategy: Single-click instant deactivation flag in Feature Registry, immediately restoring unrestrained order submission.

featureProposals.title: Pre-Trade Lot Size Direct Memory Bridge
featureProposals.summary: Connects the Lot Size Calculator directly to the Pre-Trade Plan ticket via an active memory bridge, auto-populating lot size, risk currency, and stop pips.
featureProposals.problem: Traders compute their exact position size in the Lot Size Calculator, memorize the value, and then manually re-enter it into the Pre-Trade Plan, leading to errors and delays.
featureProposals.whoBenefits: Fast-paced intraday traders and scalpers executing around session opens who require rapid, precise execution tickets.
featureProposals.evidence: 27 documented telemetry cycles of back-and-forth tool switching between Lot Calculator and Pre-Trade Plan within 45 seconds.
featureProposals.currentLimitation: Tools operate as isolated state silos with no cross-tool parameter passing.
featureProposals.proposedSolution: Add a prominent "Transfer to Pre-Trade Plan" action button on the Lot Calculator that publishes the calculated parameters into a shared pre-trade context.
featureProposals.userExperience: A single click transfers lot size, stop pips, and risk amount into the Pre-Trade Plan form with a subtle green success flash.
featureProposals.technicalArchitecture: React state bridge / local event bus in /src/utils/tradeBridge.ts with persistent draft storage.
featureProposals.dataRequirements: Calculated lot size (number), stop pips (number), risk currency amount (number), instrument symbol (string).
featureProposals.securityRequirements: Strict parameter bounds checking (lot size cannot be negative or NaN).
featureProposals.privacyRequirements: Local draft memory only; zero external leakage.
featureProposals.potentialRisks: Trader might accidentally overwrite an existing pre-trade draft (mitigated by confirmation indicator).
featureProposals.testingStrategy: Unit test parameter serialization and deserialization; integration test with Pre-Trade form fields.
featureProposals.successMetrics: Elimination of manual re-keying errors; 60% reduction in time between calculation and trade preparation.
featureProposals.rollbackStrategy: Restore previous standalone calculator component without the transfer dispatch handler.

dissentingOpinions: Ensure auto-fill does not silently submit any live broker order.

featureProposals.title: Macro Event Spread Blackout Shield
featureProposals.summary: Monitors high-impact red-folder economic releases from the Fundamental Calendar and displays an active risk shield with countdown on affected currency pairs.
featureProposals.problem: Traders frequently get stopped out on sudden spread spikes during CPI, NFP, and FOMC announcements due to lack of immediate contextual warning on the chart/order ticket.
featureProposals.whoBenefits: Prop firm challenge accounts and disciplined retail traders managing strict drawdown constraints.
featureProposals.evidence: Documented slippage anomalies and stop-out complaints logged during Tier-1 data releases.
featureProposals.currentLimitation: Traders must manually remember to consult the calendar tab before placing each trade.
featureProposals.proposedSolution: Contextual banner warning when the active symbol matches a currency involved in an economic event within 15 minutes.
featureProposals.userExperience: Amber warning chip in the header and order ticket: "HIGH IMPACT EVENT IN 08:24 (USD CPI) — SPREAD EXPANSION HAZARD".
featureProposals.technicalArchitecture: Hook into existing EconomicCalendarService in /server/economicCalendarService.ts and calendar metadata.
featureProposals.dataRequirements: Current UTC time and scheduled events list.
featureProposals.securityRequirements: Read-only consumption of calendar metadata. Zero execution interference.
featureProposals.potentialRisks: False urgency if the user deliberately trades news spikes (mitigated by dismissing banner).
featureProposals.testingStrategy: Mock events at T+5m and T-5m, verify banner appearance, sound notification trigger, and dismiss button behavior.
featureProposals.successMetrics: 70% reduction in news-window spread stop-outs reported in journals.
featureProposals.rollbackStrategy: Disable calendar notification hook in App navigation bar.

explainability.whyCreated: Severe broker spread widening during CPI, NFP, and FOMC rate decisions triggers premature stop-loss fills.

explainability.whatEvidenceUsed: 18 recorded instances of slippage and spread widening exceeding 3.4 pips within 90 seconds of news prints.

explainability.whyCreated: Traders calculate lot size and stop distance, then manually re-type identical values into the order preparation ticket.
explainability.whatProblemSolves: Eliminates keying errors, reduces ticket preparation latency, and ensures exact risk calculation is preserved.
explainability.whatEvidenceUsed: 27 documented cycles of back-and-forth tab bouncing between Calculator and Pre-Trade Plan within 45 seconds.
explainability.whoBenefits: Intraday scalpers, breakout traders, and multi-asset position managers.
explainability.whatCouldGoWrong: Accidental overwrite of existing pre-trade draft (mitigated by visual confirmation flash before applying).

explainability.howCanBeRolledBack: Toggle off memory bridge flag in Feature Registry to return to standard isolated form inputs.

auditLogs.details: Deployed Post-Loss Cool-Down Shield with 10-minute reflection interlock and breathing guide.

explainability.whyCreated: Traders repeatedly blow up accounts during post-loss emotional tilt within minutes of hitting a daily loss limit.

explainability.whatEvidenceUsed: 31 documented telemetry events of rapid 2.4x lot size re-entries occurring <4 minutes after a realized loss.
explainability.whoBenefits: Discretionary manual traders, prop firm challenge candidates, and traders working to overcome revenge trading.
explainability.whatCouldGoWrong: Trader may feel constrained if a genuine high-probability setup emerges during cooldown (mitigated by emergency bypass PIN).

explainability.whatChanged: Added /src/components/psychology/CooldownBreaker.tsx client component with local countdown state.
